tips.title: Open a part file and assign a machine definition
tips.body: Start Mastercam, select the default metric configuration file, open the part file 'single_contour.mcam', and choose a wire EDM machine definition.

tips.title: Create a contour toolpath with a single contour
tips.body: On the Wireframe tab, choose Point Position and select ThreadPoint to create a thread point for the tool path.

tips.title: Define stock model for better visualization
tips.body: In the ToolpathsManager, expand Properties under MachineGroup, click Stock Setup, and enter stock dimensions (Y75, X75, Z10) and origin (Z10).

tips.title: Select geometry for toolpaths (chaining)
tips.body: On the Wirepathstab, choose Contour and chain wireframe geometry by selecting the thread point as the first chain and the gear shape as the second chain.

tips.title: Break closest entity to thread point
tips.body: This option breaks the entity closest to the thread point into two pieces, starting the toolpath with a perpendicular move.

tips.title: Set compensation type to Computer
tips.body: This option computes the compensated wire path and does not output control codes for compensation, allowing you to see a more accurate representation of the toolpath motion.

tips.title: Set rapid height, UV trim plane, and UV height
tips.body: Set the rapid height to 15.0, the UV trim plane, and the UV height to 15.0.

tips.title: Set wire diameter for Pass 1
tips.body: Enter 0.2 for the wire diameter in Pass 1.

tips.title: Set wire overburn for Pass 1
tips.body: Enter 0.035 for the wire overburn in Pass 1.

tips.title: Set additional skim cuts before tab
tips.body: Enter 3 for the number of additional skim cuts before tab.

tips.title: Set tab width
tips.body: Enter 1.0 for the tab width.

tips.title: Set cutting method to Reverse
tips.body: Select the Reverse cutting method.

tips.title: Set lead-in and lead-out moves
tips.body: Select Line and arc for the lead-in, and Arc and line for the lead-out.

tips.title: Set arc radius and sweep for entry and exit moves
tips.body: Enter 0.125 for the arc radius and 60 for the arc sweep.

tips.title: Set max lead-out distance
tips.body: Enter 0.3 for the max lead-out distance.

tips.title: Select multiple contours
tips.body: Select multiple contours in the ToolpathsManager.

tips.title: Create multiple tabs and stops
tips.body: Create multiple tabs and stops in the ToolpathsManager.

tips.title: Change stock origin Z coordinate
tips.body: Set to 10.

tips.title: Select display and fit screen
tips.body: Show stock boundaries and include them when using the Fit to Screen function.

tips.title: Save part under a different filename
tips.body: Protect the original tutorial file from being overwritten.

tips.title: Select multiple contour geometry using window chaining
tips.body: Quickly select multiple parts by clicking Window on the Chaining dialog box.

tips.title: Set tab width for contour milling
tips.body: Enter 2.0 for the tab width to keep it from dropping out of stock.

tips.title: Select skim cut for contour milling
tips.body: Set Maketabcutoffmovewithskimcut to make the toolpath motion more efficient.

tips.title: Add finish pass after tab cutting
tips.body: Select Skimcutsaftertab to add a finish pass after cutting the tab.

tips.title: Select compensation type and direction
tips.body: Set the compensation type to Computer and the compensation direction to Left.

tips.title: Add stop code for each tab cut
tips.body: Select Foreachtab to add a stop code before the tab cut on each chain and Asgluestopto add them as optional stops.

tips.title: Set lead in and out parameters
tips.body: Select Lineandarc for the leadin and Arcandline for the leadout. Enter 0.5 for the arc radius and 90 for the arcsweep on entry and exit moves.

tips.title: Set overlap for contour milling
tips.body: Enter 0.02 for the overlap to eliminate potential burrs by overlapping the start and end of the contour by the entered amount.

tips.title: Set taper parameters for contour milling
tips.body: Select Taper and set the Rapidheight, UVtrim plane, and UVheight to 20.0.

tips.title: Sort chains in Chain Manager
tips.body: Select the Y+X option to sort the chains from right to left.

tips.title: Verify toolpath using Mastercam Simulator
tips.body: Simulate material removal in addition to tool motion.

tips.title: Zoom window in Mastercam Simulator
tips.body: Draw a window around the center part to look at the results more closely.

tips.title: Remove chips in Mastercam Simulator
tips.body: Click Remove Chipson the Verify tab and then click on the middle part to see the slug dropout of the stock.

tips.title: Select thread points for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Move cursor to the end of a slot and select the center of an arc using Mastercam’s AutoCursor.

tips.title: Define thread points for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Select four points close together to reduce travel time between slots.

tips.title: Set stock shape for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Select Cylindrical in the Shapes section and select Z as the cylinder axis.

tips.title: Set stock dimensions for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Enter 30 for the cylinder height and 40 for the diameter.

tips.title: Select closed shape for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: All chains (except thread points) must be a closed shape for NoCore toolpaths.

tips.title: Select NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Choose 'NoCore' on the Wirepath tab.

tips.title: Set rapid height and UV trim plane
tips.body: Set Rapidheight, UVtrimplane, and UVheight to 40.0.

tips.title: Select Parallel Spiral for roughing
tips.body: Choose 'ParallelSpiral' as the cutting method for the rough pass.

tips.title: Enable finish pass for finishing
tips.body: Select 'Finish' in the TreeView pane and enable the default finish pass parameters.

tips.title: Set compensation type for finish pass
tips.body: Select 'Computer' as the compensation type for the finish pass.

tips.title: Start finish pass at closest entity
tips.body: Select 'Startpassatclosestentity' to start the finish pass with the closest endpoint of the closest entity.

tips.title: Generate toolpath and save part file
tips.body: Click OK to generate the toolpath and save your part file.

tips.title: Quick verify backplot
tips.body: Select 'Quickverify' from the Backplot dialog box to display a shaded path.

tips.title: Play backplot to check material removal
tips.body: Click Play to run the backplot and confirm that all slots are machined completely.

tips.title: Import 4-axis machine
tips.body: Copy the required files to the specified folders to import the 4-axis machine.

tips.title: Select 4-axis machine definition
tips.body: Choose a different machinedefinition from the Machine tab for 4-axis toolpath creation.

tips.title: Set up 4-axis stock
tips.body: Enter cylindrical values for the stock setup in the ToolpathsManager.

tips.title: Select 4-axis geometry
tips.body: Change geometry to two planes: XY and UV, using synchronization methods like 'ByEntity'.

tips.title: Set power settings for 4-axis toolpath
tips.body: Select 'Rough&2 skim(s)' from the Sequencedrop-downlist in the Technology Databasedialogbox.

tips.title: Set UV and XY tabs to be the same size
tips.body: Enter 1.5 for the XY Tab Width in the Tabs section.

tips.title: Choose Compensation from the TreeView pane
tips.body: Set the compensation type to Computer and direction to Left.

tips.title: Add stop codes before the first tab cut on each chain
tips.body: Select Foreach tab to add a stop code and As glue stop to add them as optional stops.

tips.title: Select Line and arc for the lead-in, Arc and line for the lead-out
tips.body: Choose Leads from the TreeView pane.

tips.title: Backplot your tool motion in the same MastercamSimulator window
tips.body: Click Verify selected operations at the top of the Toolpaths Manager.

tips.title: Enable vectors to view 4-axis wire positions
tips.body: Click the Backplottab and select Enable Vectors.

tips.title: Run the backplot to see the wire move around the part
tips.body: Click Play at the bottom of the Simulator window.

tips.title: View the final part shapes to compare with tool motion
tips.body: Click Workpiece to toggle between different shades of translucency.
